title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
summary_full: The unidentified object caused a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine during a Russian attack on the city of Lviv.
